title: RBI Raises Bank Dividend Payout Cap to 75% of PAT
summary: RBI proposes raising dividend payout ceiling for commercial banks from 40% to 75% of PAT effective FY2026-27.

blocks.content: RBI proposed lifting the maximum dividend payout ratio for commercial banks from **40% to 75% of Profit After Tax (PAT)**, governed by a 10-bucket CET1 capital strength matrix.

items: **Exclusions**: Excludes Small Finance Banks, Payments Banks, RRBs, and Local Area Banks.
**Adjusted PAT Formula**: PAT minus net NPAs as of 31 March.

provenance.sourceTitle: RBI Raises Bank Dividend Payout Cap to 75% of PAT
